checks.title: WiPrPrüfV current consolidation, amendment 11 December 2024
checks.method: Independent read of actual primary bytes reused from the temporary shared research download; no duplicate retained.
checks.read_extent: Header; complete sections 4–7, 13, 15–19 and 22, physical pp. 4–10.
checks.check: Header last amendment 11 December 2024. Four modules; every ordinary module has written and oral components. Existing BWL/VWL has two papers; general duration is four to six hours. Section 4 includes professional standards, audit approach and execution, other reporting engagements and other business audits. Section 13 averages two papers.
